custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day after this release, date A, at a cost of $10.00, with 0 in its only bin.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C540878 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540878-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 0 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Do this one day before you run the test, then run the test the next day, so the report has saved a figure for that earlier date.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line on date A while its bin holds 0, so part A ended date A at -2 and the report saved that figure for date A.
    • How to do it: On that same day: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C540878 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the work order's Lines tab, in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540878-A in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 2 in Qty *, then click Save.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
